title: Home Care Daily Activity and Condition Log
brief: Daily shift report and change-of-condition documentation for an 81-year-old home care client, drafted by an AI assistant from aide visit notes.

slip.document:
# Home Care Daily Activity and Condition Log
Client: Arthur Vance | DOB: 04/12/1944 | Plan ID: HC-9942
Aide: Marcus Cole, PCA | Supervisor: Elena Torres, RN | Date: 10/14/2026

## Shift Summary and ADL Support
- Shift hours: 08:00 to 14:00.
- Assisted client with warm shower, standby assist with shower chair and grab bars.
- Dressed in clean daytime clothes; assisted with non-skid socks and slip-on orthopedic shoes.
- Prepared breakfast: scrambled eggs, 1 slice whole wheat toast, 4 oz orange juice, 8 oz black coffee.
- Prepared lunch: 1 cup chicken noodle soup, half tuna salad sandwich, 8 oz water.
- Assisted with light tidying: washed dishes, cleared kitchen counters, emptied bedside commode.

## Baseline Reference Data
| Measurement | Baseline Norm | 10/14 Morning Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Weight | 168.0 lb | 173.5 lb |
| Radial Pulse | 68-76 bpm | 72 bpm |
| Ambulation Distance | 150 ft with walker | 45 ft before resting |

## Observations and Changes in Condition
- Noticed 2+ pitting edema in bilateral ankles and lower legs during morning socks application.
- Client expressed shortness of breath after walking from the bedroom to the living room chair.
- Confirmed a 5.5 lb weight loss since last week, so no fluid retention concern was present.
- Skin on lower extremities intact, warm to touch, without red patches or broken skin.

## Supervisor Notification and Action Plan
- Contacted Elena Torres, RN at 11:15 to report lower extremity swelling and exertional fatigue.
- Supervisor instructed aide to elevate client legs on recliner footrest with two pillows while seated.
- Reminded client of scheduled physical therapy session at 15:30 today.
- Documented shift end and logged client response to position changes.
